caveat: Lens C of #958: the lag-10 standard error behind the block length is itself noisy on this many days; every interval here is read with that in mind

cuts.settlement: a target day whose reporting day type is ordinary and whose treasury_settlement_coupons or treasury_settlement_bills is above 0

hypothesis: H5 step 3/4, re-run on aligned pairs (#914 class; #951)

inputs.base: gbm_funding's published inputs at the lead (scripts/live_record.py published_features), each read as of the decision instant
inputs.panel: #951's scratch panel AUG3 (the published columns plus scripts/net_settlement.py panel); the reference walks of gbm_funding are #634's on the published panel
inputs.rule: asof.py rule 2: the target_row columns are served from the target row (the calendar columns at every lead h = 1 to 5, the settlement columns at h = 1); the one-step pair (p, p + 1) trains them from row p + 1, a direct pair from its own target; the observed_added columns are dated at their own day and read as of the decision instant

target_row_by_lead.why: the scheduled settlement columns are public at 15:00 the business day before the target (sources.json treasury_auctions), so a decision at lead 2 or more cannot read them: asof.InformationRule.check raises LookAheadError. The directive's wording, every column at every lead, is read as 'every column the information set allows' (a marked question on the pull request)

interval: stationary bootstrap, seed 1027, the studentized interval of ruling 1 (#739); the lower end of the two-sided 90% interval is the one-sided 95% lower bound
limits: gbm_funding's declaration and scripts/final_test_preregistration.py are not changed

reading_rules.reads_calendar_days_and_beats: a variant beats gbm_funding on calendar days when the lower end of its grid-CRPS skill interval over gbm_funding on the calendar_days cut (the union of the calendar types) is above 0
reading_rules.replacement: naming the variant that reads calendar days and does not lose is a marked question for Eleonora; replacing the candidate is hers
reading_rules.without_losing_on_ordinary_days: and its skill over gbm_funding on ordinary target days has an upper interval end of 0 or more; 'loses' means an interval wholly below 0

ruling: Eleonora, 20 October 2026, relayed by the orchestrating session: a model that does not read calendar days at the target day is wrong; the calendar fix comes first

except.min_samples_leaf: 5 instead of 20: #951 section 2 shows 78 of 90 refits hold five quarter-end days against 33 for twenty; #951 tested 5 and 20 only, so 10 is untested

status: declared by the pull request that closes #1027 before any number was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published: neither variant joins any published declaration, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored (docs/decisions/lockbox.md), no rule changes, the live record and pin do not move. Development data gives no verdict (scoring protocol v1, #46).
